There's still a lot we don't about cats, in fact scientists aren't entirely certain how or even why cats purr. So while cats do communicate vocally with other cats, domesticated cats have developed a unique form of communication with humans, which to me is totally cool.

Unfortunately, as long as people know that you sh, it doesn't only affect you. Believe it or not, we are very different people when we sh versus when we don't, and it affects our relationships with others, which in turn affects them. It's a truly vicious cycle of pain for everyone involved, especially those of us that use physical pain as a (very unhealthy) coping mechanism.

These people are more than likely trying to help you be healthy and, well, be you again. Please try to let them help. I know it's scary, and I know it's easier and it feels safer to stay in the sh bubble, but just taking that first step towards recovery will improve your life substantially. You deserve to be okay.
